name: Time Interloper
source:
Enjoying a dinner after the release of your own OS, you're quickly yanked somewhere else... or somewhen else? You're playing as Griff a young man who has created a new OS with your best friend Joel. 

You are soon sucked into time to maybe prevent the very thing you created. 

Do you do it, or do you pick romance? What will be the cost, or the paradox? 

Too soon to tell. 

Currently in development - Now in indefinite Hiatus

Entry for Bara Jam 2019.

[From [url=https://gryphbear.itch.io/time-interloper]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你刚发布了自己开发的操作系统，正享用晚餐，却突然被拖到了另一个地方……或者说，另一个时间？你将扮演年轻人格里夫，与挚友乔尔共同开发了一款全新的操作系统。

不久，你被卷入时间之中，或许是为了阻止自己亲手创造的东西问世。

你会这样做，还是选择爱情？又将付出怎样的代价，引发怎样的悖论？

现在还言之过早。

作品原在开发中，目前已无限期暂停开发。

Bara Jam 2019参赛作品。

[摘自[url=https://gryphbear.itch.io/time-interloper]Itch.io[/url]]
